request.instructions: 你是一个专业的文档分析师，擅长从技术文档中提取关键信息。
request.prompt:
从下面这份 PPAP 文件的内容中摘录业务信息。只返回 JSON：
{"project": 项目, "customer": 客户, "model": 车型, "part_number": 零件号, "part": 零件名称, "blank": [标签存在但值为空或占位的字段名]}

- 零件号、零件名称：取表头区或标签处写明的值。标签写法如「零件号 / 零件编号 / 件号 / 产品件号 / 零件代号 / 物料编号 / 测量对象 / Part No. / Part Number」「零件名称 / 产品名称 / 零件名 / Part Name」。值可能在标签右侧，也可能在标签正下方的格子里（标签在上、值在下）。
- 写在名称栏里、但内容是件号编码的值归 part_number，不归 part；一格内件号与名称连写（如 F01RD0YA41毛坯壳体）时，件号归 part_number、名称归 part。
- 项目、客户、车型：只取写明了「项目 / Project」「客户 / Customer / 顾客 / 接受方 / 买方 / 采购方」「车型 / Vehicle」这类标签的值；不从文件名、文件编号（如 QJ-FMEA-GEELY-776）、表单号、公司名或没有标签的格子推断。
- 照录原文，不改写、不翻译、不统一写法。同一格或同一栏内并列写了多个值时全部照录：分行或分列写的返回字符串列表，一格内用「/」并列的原样返回。一列里（如「产品名称/零件号」列）出现多个不同的值时，按出现顺序全部列出；相同的值只列一次。同一标签在每页页眉重复出现时只取第一处。
- 标签存在但值为空或只是占位（如 /、-、N/A、TBD、待定、待确认、XXXX、CPJ-XXXXXX 这类模板占位）时，该字段返回 null，并把字段名放进 blank。
- 文件里没有该字段时返回 null。

4 
Manufacturing 
The steelmaking processes (e.g., melting, secondary metallurgy, casting) are to be ensured with regard to high require-
ments in order to avoid macroscopic defects, non-metallic inclusions and defects. 
The steelmaking and production of the semi-finished material up to the product to be delivered follow the Control Plans in 
accordance with IATF 16949:2016-10. The Control Plans are referenced in the initial sample test report. 
5 
Defects 
5.1 General 
In accordance with state-of-the-art technology, the products have to be free from defects, which impair 
 
the processability under real production conditions 
 
the use under real service conditions. 
Details may be agreed relating to the component. 
5.2 Macroscopic internal defects 
Macroscopic internal defects are e.g. 
 
non-metallic inclusions with a surface of more than 0,03 mm² in their largest dimension 
 
internal discontinuities as e.g. blowholes, pores or internal cracks with a surface of more than 0,03 mm² in the 
largest dimension 
Quantity and size of macroscopic internal defects must not exceed the current state-of-the-art technology. State-of-the-art 
measures are to be taken in order to avoid the occurrence of macroscopic internal defects. Material with a heightened risk 
of such defects must not be delivered. In particular, any deviation from the control plan can heighten the risk. 
6

6.1

of the final treatment of the melt. All adequate preparations have to be made in order to avoid the addition of such ele-
ments from the scrap and other materials used in manufacturing that impair the mechanical properties and the usability of 
the steel.

10 Additional requirements 
10.1 
Microstructure (in delivery condition) 
Ferrite and lamellar pearlite, no ferrite/pearlite bands, which may impair the machining. 
10.2 
Straightness 
The straightness has to guarantee a flawless processability, permissible deviation from straightness max. 1,0 mm/m ac-
cording to table 4 in DIN EN 10278:1999-12. 
10.3 
Microscopic degree of purity  
10.3.1 
The manganese sulfides shall be distributed as homogeneously as possible over the cross-section. Size and distribution 
of the manganese sulfides have to correspond to standard diagram plate for Stahl-Eisen Testing Guideline SEP 
1572:1971-08, column 2, lines 2 and 3. 
10.3.2 
The manganese sulfides shall be distributed as homogeneously as possible over the cross-section. Manganese sulfide 
size and manganese sulfide distribution have to correspond to standard diagram plate for Stahl-Eisen Testing Guideline 
SEP 1572:1971-08, column 1, lines 1 and 2 and column 2, lines 1 and 2. 
10.4 
Coercive field strength of the annealed round bars 
The heat treatment to achieve magnetic properties is performed in accordance with an internal steel mill process specifi-
cation that has to be coordinated with the responsible CoC Materials. This process specification is part of the control plan, 
which is referenced in the initial sample test report.
